Rules.InvariantScript:
Set(varShowSubmitErrors, true);

If(
    IsBlank(FacilitiesServiceSubcategoryDropdownM.Selected.Value),
    Notify(
        "Please select a Service Subcategory.",
        NotificationType.Error
    ),

    FacilitiesServiceSubcategoryDropdownM.Selected.Value = "Parking Request" &&
    IsBlank(FacilitiesParkingLocationDropdownM.Selected.Value),
    Notify(
        "Please select a Parking Location.",
        NotificationType.Error
    ),

    FacilitiesServiceSubcategoryDropdownM.Selected.Value = "Building Maintenance" &&
    IsBlank(FacilitiesRequestTypeDropdownM.Selected.Value),
    Notify(
        "Please select a Request Type.",
        NotificationType.Error
    ),

    SubmitForm(FacilitiesRequestFormM)
)

Table(
    {Value: "Parking Request"},
    {Value: "Locksmith Request"},
    {Value: "Badge Access"},
    {Value: "Space/Office Request"},
    {Value: "Building Maintenance"},
    {Value: "Filtered Water Requests"}
)

Table(
    {Value: "Conference/Training Room Scheduling"},
    {Value: "General Repairs / Exterior / Elevators"},
    {Value: "Furniture"},
    {Value: "Pest Control"},
    {Value: "Electrical/Lighting"},
    {Value: "Heating / Cooling / Ventilation"},
    {Value: "Alarms"},
    {Value: "Signage"},
    {Value: "Plumbing/Restroom"},
    {Value: "Janitorial and Cleaning"},
    {Value: "Security Systems"}
)

If(
    varShowSubmitErrors &&
    FacilitiesServiceSubcategoryDropdownM.Selected.Value = "Building Maintenance" &&
    IsBlank(FacilitiesRequestTypeDropdownM.Selected.Value),
    "Request Type is required.",
    Parent.Error
)

Switch(
    FacilitiesParkingLocationDropdownM.Selected.Value,
    "Civic Center",
    "Civic Center parking is paid and has a waiting list. Your request will be reviewed.",
    "Other parking locations (free)",
    "Parking at this location is free. You do not need to submit a request. No further action is necessary.",
    ""
)

Switch(
    FacilitiesServiceSubcategoryDropdownM.Selected.Value,
    "Parking Request", "Reason for Parking Request",
    "Locksmith Request", "Reason for Locksmith Request",
    "Badge Access", "Reason for Badge Access",
    "Space/Office Request", "Reason for Space/Office Request",
    "Filtered Water Requests", "Description of Water Service Request",
    "Building Maintenance", "Description",
    "Description"
)
"The requested file could not be downloaded."
